summary.en: Colombian security forces stormed a supermarket in Cartagena, freeing all 20 hostages after gunmen held them for 17 hours and killing one attacker. The president blamed ex-FARC rebels for a car bomb that injured more than 20 people in a central city and for another bomb at the governor's office in Meta. The ELN carried out a drone strike on a police base, wounding three people including an infant. Violence remains high, with 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Colombianske sikkerhetsstyrker stormet et supermarked i Cartagena, frigjorde alle 20 gissel etter at væpnede menn hadde holdt dem i 17 timer, og drepte en angriper. Presidenten la skylden på eks-FARC-opprørerne for en bilbombe som såret mer enn 20 personer i en sentral del av byen, og for en annen bombe ved guvernørkontoret i Meta. ELN utførte et droneangrep på en politibase, og såret tre personer, inkludert et spedbarn. Voldighetene er fortsatt høye, med 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
